class.name: CgameFormations
class.brief_description: Group formation slot layouts, optimal slot assignment and obstacle-aware slot shifting.
class.description: Native port of the Cgame GDScript formation helpers. Slot layouts are expressed in leader space: [code]+X[/code] is the leader's forward direction and [code]+Y[/code] the leader's right (screen-space 2D, y down). Slot 0 of [code]"wedge"[/code] and [code]"column"[/code] sits on the leader. Supported kinds are [code]"line"[/code], [code]"wedge"[/code], [code]"circle"[/code] and [code]"column"[/code] (see [method get_kinds]); unknown kinds fall back to a column. Members are matched to slots with the Hungarian (Kuhn-Munkres) algorithm, which minimises the total member to slot distance, for up to [constant HUNGARIAN_LIMIT] members and slots; larger groups use a greedy nearest-free-slot pass. All methods are static and deterministic.

method.name: assign
method.description: Returns an array where entry [code]i[/code] is the slot index assigned to member [code]i[/code], minimising the total member to slot distance. If there are more members than slots, the surplus members receive [code]-1[/code].

method.name: assignment_cost
method.description: Returns the total member to slot distance of [param assignment]. Entries of [code]-1[/code] are skipped.

method.name: blend
method.description: Linearly blends two layouts. The result has the size of [param to_slots]; slots without a counterpart in [param from_slots] start at their goal. [param t] is clamped to [code][0, 1][/code].

method.name: get_kinds
method.description: Returns the supported formation kinds: [code]line[/code], [code]wedge[/code], [code]circle[/code] and [code]column[/code].

method.name: shift_slots
method.description: Moves slots that are not walkable to the nearest walkable position found by a ring search, keeping at least [code]spacing * 0.5[/code] from slots already placed. Walkable slots are never moved. If no ring yields a position, the slot is pulled toward [param leader_pos]. [param walkable] is called as [code]walkable(position: Vector2) -> bool[/code].

method.name: slots
method.description: Returns [param count] slot offsets in leader space, at least [param spacing] apart. Returns an empty array when [param count] is not positive.

method.name: smooth
method.description: Frame-rate independent smoothing of the current slot positions toward [param goal], for use when the formation kind or size changes. Equivalent to [method blend] with [code]1 - exp(-rate * dt)[/code].

method.name: targets
method.description: Returns world-space slot targets for a leader at [param leader_pos] facing [param leader_heading] (radians).

constants.constant: Largest group (members and slots) assigned with the Hungarian algorithm; larger groups use the greedy fallback.
